journeys.name: Member Enrollment
journeys.description: End-to-end member enrollment process from application submission through eligibility verification and plan activation

steps.name: Application Submission
steps.description: Member submits enrollment application via web or mobile

steps.name: Identity Verification
steps.description: Verify member identity through enterprise identity provider

steps.name: Eligibility Check
steps.description: Validate member eligibility against plan rules and external sources

steps.name: Enrollment Processing
steps.description: Process enrollment record and activate member plan

steps.name: Event Publishing
steps.description: Publish enrollment event to downstream systems via Kafka

steps.name: Billing Account Setup
steps.description: Create billing account and generate initial premium invoice

businessImpact.description: Directly impacts new member acquisition and revenue growth. Enrollment failures during open enrollment periods can result in regulatory penalties.

scenarioButtons.label: Simulate Enrollment Spike
scenarioButtons.description: Simulate 10x enrollment volume during open enrollment period

scenarioButtons.label: Eligibility Service Outage
scenarioButtons.description: Simulate eligibility verification service becoming unavailable

scenarioButtons.label: Database Failover
scenarioButtons.description: Simulate Oracle DB failover for enrollment engine

journeys.name: Claims Processing
journeys.description: Complete claims lifecycle from submission through adjudication, payment, and EOB generation

steps.name: Claim Submission
steps.description: Receive claim via EDI 837 transaction or provider portal

steps.name: EDI Processing
steps.description: Parse and validate EDI transaction format

steps.name: Event Routing
steps.description: Route claim event to adjudication engine via Kafka

steps.name: Claims Adjudication
steps.description: Apply business rules and adjudicate claim using Drools engine

steps.name: Payment Processing
steps.description: Process provider payment through billing engine

steps.name: EOB Generation
steps.description: Generate Explanation of Benefits document for member

steps.name: Data Lake Ingestion
steps.description: Ingest claims data into enterprise data lake for analytics

businessImpact.description: Core revenue-generating process. Claims adjudication failures directly impact provider payments, member satisfaction, and regulatory compliance. SLA breaches trigger financial penalties.

scenarioButtons.label: Adjudication Engine Failure
scenarioButtons.description: Simulate complete claims adjudication engine outage

scenarioButtons.description: Simulate large EDI batch file processing (100K+ claims)

scenarioButtons.label: Rule Engine Memory Leak
